description.character_limit_note: Unverified. No description length cap was stated on the official Etsy pages opened in the check dated 2026-11-05. Do not build generator logic on a description limit until it is verified.
description.keyword_guidance: Etsy search considers keywords and phrases within listing descriptions when ranking listings. Aim to incorporate relevant keywords in the first few sentences. Avoid copying the title verbatim or simply listing top keywords.

digital.file_name_rules: File names are limited to 70 alphanumeric characters, periods, underscores, or hyphens. The file names buyers see are the same ones uploaded. There is no way of editing the name after uploading.

first_photo.min_px_note: First listing photo at least 635 px width and height to avoid showing up lower in searches.
first_photo.orientation_note: First photo should be horizontal (landscape) or square, so the centre focal point appears in cropped thumbnail views. The same help page also says in its thumbnail section to avoid square crops and upload horizontal or landscape images. Generator rule: use a landscape or square master, keep the product centred with a safe border, and do not rely on edge text surviving a crop.
first_photo.text_rule: Avoid text overlays, collages, or using a collection of images for the first thumbnail when optimising the first listing for search.

image.accepted_formats_note: Animated .gif files and transparent .png files are not supported. If a file contains transparency, the transparent parts will appear black on Etsy.
image.background_guidance: Keep the background simple, a clean neutral background ensures the focus stays on the product. This is guidance, not a pure white background rule.
image.hard_max_file_size_note: Unverified. The official page gives a 1MB upload warning only, not a hard cap. Images larger than 1MB in file size may not finish uploading, especially on a slower internet connection. Do not state a hard cap as an Etsy rule.
image.max_pixel_dimension_note: Unverified. No upper pixel limit was stated on the official pages opened in the check dated 2026-11-05.

name: Etsy digital v1

tags.allowed_characters: Tags can only include spaces, letters, and numbers. A seller is able to use the apostrophe and hyphen within words and phrases, but cannot start a tag with these characters.

title.guidance: Consider using less than 15 words, include the most important traits upfront, move subjective words like perfect or beautiful to the description, try not to repeat words, do not add price, shipping, or sales information.
